title: Fewer Errors, but More Stereotypes? The Effect of Model Size on Gender Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Prompt-based Masked Language Modeling (MLM) comparing normalized probabilities of predicting gendered pronouns ('he' vs. 'she') for masked occupations, and evaluating coreference resolution errors (specifically identifying stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical errors) using the Winogender benchmark formatted as a Natural Language Inference (NLI) task.
